{{Quote|Your money's always good here.|Xanta|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Xanta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="SWTOR" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Jedipedia-NPCData" /> who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the war, they held the rank of [[Private/Legends|private]] and was stationed on the Sith [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where they worked as a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]]. Xanta sold weapons from a stall near the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]], some of which other [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] tested on a target that was attached to their stall. They had tanned skin, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. While at their stall, they wore a gray Imperial [[Clothing/Legends|uniform]] with black [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and had their hair tied in a bun.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Xanta first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying game]]. ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. In the game, they serve as a weapons vendor.<ref name="SWTOR" />
